reading.title: After the flood
reading.text: The floods of last autumn were unprecedented: rainfall in the region exceeded the average for the whole year in just three days. When the water finally receded, thousands of homes were damaged and several villages were inaccessible by road. Engineers had warned in the preceding decade that the river defences were too low. The government has now conceded that it ignored those warnings, and it plans to proceed with a new flood barrier. However, with the country close to recession, many residents doubt that the money will arrive soon.
